facts.summary: FDA says single-arm Phase 2 data insufficient, discouraged filing; randomized trial needed · Phase 2 · zandelisib in follicular lymphoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the FDA informed the companies of its position that a randomized trial is now needed to adequately assess drug efficacy and safety of PI3K inhibitor drug candidates, including zandelisib.
evidence.safety: In line with previously reported data from the Phase 1B study, zandelisib was generally well tolerated.
evidence.program_discontinued: Nonetheless we will continue to focus on the ongoing Phase 3 COASTAL study
